description: Sonar — PRIVATE · SEALED · POST-QUANTUM MESSENGER (broadcast to everyone, understood by one, remembered by none). Hybrid ML-KEM-768+X25519 encryption, a one-time stealth handle per message, fixed-size ciphertexts, 60 s release grid. The server stores only (ephemeralPubKey, viewTag, ct) — no sender, no recipient, no IP. Returns mode, ciphertext sizes, release grid, cover-row rate and the honest anonymity accounting (kContribution is 0: rotating handles give unlinkability, not extra participants). Read-only.
